title: clinopodium teydense
intro: Clinopodium teydense, commonly known as Cuban oregano, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, as well as its antimicrobial properties that can aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium teydense include its antispasmodic and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve coughs and spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
